title: Bound task-sync execution-hold checks without scanning dormant-run histories
outcome: Folder import decides live execution holds from indexed run authority and avoids reading every dormant child's entire event history.
acceptance: Import under a root with many dormant child runs avoids per-child full canonical history decoding for authority that indexed claim and handoff rows can determine.
Live claims, live handoffs and any supported claim-less execution fallback retain their existing hold behavior, with behavioral and work-count coverage.
